digest.component_or_area: rich-emission state mutation and binding store facade
propositions: Production rich-emission state is currently mutated through all_bindings() query result in apply_handlers._observe_rich_reemit instead of using the narrow BindingStore.note_rich_emit facade accessor.
The docstring at _observe_rich_reemit falsely claims binding_store.py cannot carry a narrower accessor because it is at module-size cap, but S2 T3 added such an accessor and the file is 554 lines.
BindingStore.note_rich_emit must replace the mutation-through-query pattern while preserving hashes, counters, missing-binding fail-open behavior, and all existing logs and baseline effects.
ADR 0099 must be finalized with tombstone authority, explicit-unretire reversal rules, the realized pre-observation repair boundary, and the prohibition on broad tickets-branch staging.
No production module code must mutate a binding through all_bindings(); benign readers (binding_walk, reconcile_helpers, reconcile_check, _commands/bridge_repair) are allowed and must be documented.
The rich-emission invocation must be positioned between the staleness gate and first fetch in reconcile.py, not in run_differs.py, per test_repair_runs_before_the_first_remote_observation.
